BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare spiced mashed potato.
Step 2: Fry the mashed potato mixture into vadas.
Step 3: Serve in a bun with chutney.
Suggestion: Use baked vadas instead of fried for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Fill puris with spicy tamarind water.
Step 2: Add potato and chickpeas inside each puri.
Step 3: Serve immediately.
Suggestion: Use less tamarind and sugar for a healthier option.

Ingredients: Chickpea flour, Yogurt, Mustard, Green chili
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare the batter using chickpea flour, yogurt, and spices.
Step 2: Steam the batter until cooked.
Step 3: Season with mustard and green chili.
Suggestion: Use less oil for a lighter version.

Ingredients: All-purpose flour, Potatoes, Peas, Spices, Oil
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare dough with all-purpose flour and water.
Step 2: Cook spiced potato and pea filling.
Step 3: Fill the dough, shape into triangles, and deep fry.
Suggestion: Use whole wheat flour and bake instead of frying for a healthier version.

Ingredients: Chickpea flour, Onions, Spinach, Spices, Oil
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mix chickpea flour with water, spices, and chopped onions/spinach.
Step 2: Fry spoonfuls of the batter until golden.
Suggestion: Air fry instead of deep frying to reduce oil content.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mash boiled potatoes with spices and bread crumbs.
Step 2: Shape into patties and shallow fry until crispy.
Suggestion: Use oats or multigrain crumbs instead of bread crumbs for added fiber.

Ingredients: Puffed rice, Sev, Tamarind chutney, Vegetables, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mix puffed rice with chopped vegetables and spices.
Step 2: Add tamarind chutney and sev, and serve immediately.
Suggestion: Replace sev with roasted peanuts for a healthier crunch.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare dough with all-purpose flour.
Step 2: Fill with spiced lentil filling and shape into balls.
Step 3: Deep fry until crispy.
Suggestion: Bake instead of frying and use whole wheat flour for added nutrition.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook sprouts with spices and a spicy gravy.
Step 2: Serve with pav, chopped onions, and lemon.
Suggestion: Use whole wheat pav and limit the oil for a healthier version.

Ingredients: Papdi (fried flour discs), Yogurt, Tamarind chutney, Sev, Vegetables
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Arrange papdi on a plate.
Step 2: Top with yogurt, chutneys, chopped vegetables, and sev.
Step 3: Serve immediately.
Suggestion: Use baked papdi and low-fat yogurt for a lighter version.

Ingredients: All-purpose flour, Chickpea flour, Spices, Oil
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare a dough with all-purpose flour.
Step 2: Roll with a spiced chickpea flour filling.
Step 3: Cut into rolls and fry until golden.
Suggestion: Bake instead of frying and use whole wheat flour for added fiber.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook mashed vegetables with spices to make a thick gravy.
Step 2: Serve with buttered pav and chopped onions.
Suggestion: Use less butter and whole wheat pav for a healthier version.

Ingredients: Potatoes, White peas, Spices, Tamarind chutney, Sev
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare potato patties and cook ragda (white pea curry).
Step 2: Serve patties topped with ragda, chutneys, and sev.
Suggestion: Bake the patties instead of frying and use low-oil ragda preparation.

Ingredients: Pav (bread), Mashed potatoes, Tamarind chutney, Pomegranate seeds, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mix mashed potatoes with spices and tamarind chutney.
Step 2: Stuff into pav along with pomegranate seeds and roasted peanuts.
Step 3: Toast on a tawa with butter.
Suggestion: Use whole wheat pav and skip butter for a lighter option.

Ingredients: Sabudana (tapioca pearls), Potatoes, Peanuts, Spices, Oil
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mix soaked sabudana with mashed potatoes, peanuts, and spices.
Step 2: Shape into vadas and fry until golden.
Suggestion: Air fry or bake the vadas to reduce oil content.

Ingredients: Chickpea flour, Yogurt, Spices, Curry leaves
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Mix chickpea flour, yogurt, and spices to form a batter.
Step 2: Steam the batter until cooked.
Step 3: Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Suggestion: Use low-fat yogurt and skip tempering oil for a healthier option.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate paneer and vegetables with spiced yogurt.
Step 2: Grill or bake until lightly charred.
Suggestion: Use low-fat yogurt for the marinade.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Grind soaked moong dal into a batter.
Step 2: Add spices and chopped vegetables.
Step 3: Cook on a hot tawa like a pancake.
